chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning obtains three Innate Supreme Treasures: Void Boat, Nine-Life Tower & the Killing Bead
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning pushes his Arcane Art and Starseizing Hand to new heights, then unlocks Daofather Threelives’s final chamber to claim three legendary Innate Supreme-grade Spirit-Treasures—each with a mind of its own.
og_title: Ji Ning’s Ultimate Escapes & a Killing Treasure from the Dawn War
og_description: After a deadly one-day cultivation binge, Ji Ning breaks the ancient prohibition and meets the spirits of three supreme treasures: a boat that shatters space, a tower that creates nine perfect decoys, and a bead that hungers for blood.
twitter_title: Ji Ning unlocks three Innate Supreme treasures: escape, decoy, and murder.
twitter_description: Eight-Nine Arcane Art completed. Starseizing Hand fifth cycle. Now he faces the final test: can he control the killing bead from the Dawn War?

lore_anchors.definition: A top-ten divine ability created by Daofather Threelives, turning the cultivator’s hands into weapons of mass destruction; the fifth cycle makes them comparable to Pure Yang treasures.
A treasure born from primordial chaos or natural essence, possessing a sentient spirit; superior to human-crafted artifacts and often with unique laws.
An ancient Chaos treasure capable of shattering the void and flying at speeds ranking in the top five of the primordial era; used for escape.
A divine treasure that allows the user to create nine indistinguishable avatars for fleeing and misdirection; even Lady Nuwa could not tell them apart.
The creator of the Starseizing Hand, a powerful True God who perished in the Dawn War; his final inheritance is left for the new Prefectural Lord of Starseizing Manor.
The personal domain and legacy fortress of Daofather Threelives, guarded by seven Empyrean Gods who remained loyal after his death.
